objective: review resident batch sweep and choose the next optimization workstream

decision.reason: resident batch sweep shows strong per-state-step amortization, so the next runtime-facing question is whether state residency can reduce repeated decode-like host/GPU boundary cost without changing the correctness policy
decision.deferred_reason: paged-attention scale-up remains useful, but resident state reuse is the narrower follow-up to the current sweep evidence

next_experiment_contract.name: resident_state_reuse_experiment
next_experiment_contract.goal: define and measure whether repeated decode-like steps can reuse resident state across host/GPU boundaries more directly than the current per-run init-state flow
required_outputs: an explicit gate before runtime ABI changes
a documented public command or dry-run command
contract tests for source reports and mismatch count
first_design_questions: can init-state generation be reused across samples without hiding source evidence
can resident execution report launch/setup time separately from kernel time
can repeated decode-like work be expressed as a single public CLI flow
which state is authoritative when CPU and GPU both advance across multiple resident phases
